objective: Same mean production-stage variance proxy and separate pilot/production cost model as campaign-production-allocation-v1; no claim that pilot work can yet be pooled into the final estimator.
allocation: For available production effort R and N edges, floor=max(1, alpha*R/N); solve n_i=max(floor, lambda*w_i), sum n_i=R. Infeasible if R<N. Pilot cost is deducted before R is computed.
fallback: Uniform allocation without buying a pilot is an explicit candidate for each phase and budget.
selection: Per phase and budget, choose predictor/alpha or uniform fallback minimizing mean variance proxy on the frozen validation campaign only. No strict-test targets, diagnostics or edge membership may enter selection.
tie_breaking: Within 1e-12 relative risk: prefer uniform fallback, then learned pilot-only, then hypersphere; within an adaptive predictor prefer the larger uniform fraction.
training: First protection ablation reuses frozen predictors. A squared-spread/RMS predictor requires a separately specified training experiment.
diagnostic_rules: No BAR-overlap cutoff or case-specific exception is introduced here. Audit case IDs are never allocation features or exclusion rules.
comparison: Retain unprotected allocations as historical controls; alpha=0 is not a selection candidate. Report all policies and the validation-selected policy.
confirmation: The existing strict campaign is retrospective development evidence. An additional untouched campaign is needed for confirmation of this revised design.
implementation_gate: Review source-work audit and label reliability before implementing or running validation selection.
